title: Chapter 2889 - 155: Death Battle at the Divine Altar
content:
Chapter 2889: Chapter 155: Death Battle at the Divine Altar

The Black Vulture Elder, who survived the Vermilion Bird arrow with a broken body and resolute spirit, gazed hopefully at the Divine Altar, climbing step by step under the burning Vermilion Bird Fire.

"Kill him! We must not let him summon the god!" Chief Dan Lie shouted sternly.

The previous arrow had already exhausted most of his cultivation.

At this moment, despite Chief Dan Lie’s steady tone, it carried a hint of weakness and fear towards the Witch Vulture God Descent.

Chieftain Lugu and several other chiefs also knew the situation was critical; once the Wujiu Great God descended, all would be lost with no chance of reversal.

However, they had late-stage Golden Core cultivation, but their Divine Sense was ordinary, unable to withstand the burning Vermilion Bird Fire, incapable of venturing onto the altar.

Moreover, they were typical Barbarian Tribe body cultivators, strong in close combat but weak in long-range attacks.

Some long-range means might temporarily kill lower-realm Golden Core cultivators, but to kill shamans before the Young Master of Wujiu Tribe and a group of generals was obviously wishful thinking.

At this moment, Yan Zhu stepped forward, saying:

"Everyone, assist me in ascending the altar."

In this Divine Altar war, as it battled on, Yan Zhu, being the Upper Witch of the Royal Court, had not made significant moves.

In other words, he had been "gathering strength."

Melee combat against Golden Core bodies was not the task of shamans.

The confrontation on the altar was their primary mission.

Qing Zhu also stepped forward, saying, "Let us kill the Black Vulture Elder and prevent the god summoning."

Chief Dan Lie bowed his hands in gratitude, saying in a deep voice, "I entrust this to both of you."

Yan Zhu spoke no more, turning into a flash of fire and darting towards the altar.

Qing Zhu followed closely, surrounded by a clear light.

Their escape lights rushed halfway when the Young Master of Wujiu Tribe sneered, "Seeking death," and immediately activated the Dragon Pattern, with black strength killing towards Yan Zhu and Qing Zhu.

Other generals of the Wujiu Tribe also surrounded them.

Dan Lie and Lugu, along with other tribal chiefs, also took action, battling with the generals of Wujiu Tribe, trying to buy time for Yan Zhu and Qing Zhu to ascend the altar.

Both sides killed hundreds of rounds, yet still at a stalemate.

Seeing the Black Vulture Elder climb higher and higher towards the altar, Yan Zhu no longer held back.

With a murderous look and eyes flashing with fire, he unleashed Divine Thought Witchcraft, joining fingers together, and at the closest moment, pointed at the eye of a Wujiu Tribe general.

This was a move he used on Mo Hua initially.

The Wujiu Tribe general felt his eyes burn, and his Sea of Consciousness boiled with pain.

This move was harmless and itchy used on Mo Hua of the late Foundation Establishment,

But used on a late-stage Golden Core Wujiu Tribe general, it was instantly extraordinary.

Moreover, it was in the Divine Altar Square, surrounded by Vermilion Bird Fire.

While the fire on the square was less fierce than that on the altar, its power should not be underestimated.

The Wujiu Tribe general, with his Sea of Consciousness defense broken by Yan Zhu’s Divine Thought Witchcraft, then suffered Vermilion Bird Fire entering his mind, with two same-source divine thought powers amplifying each other, instantly destroying the general’s intent.

The Wujiu Tribe general held his head, knelt on the ground, and died with fire flowing through his eyes.

Yan Zhu struck, killing a Wujiu Tribe general.

On the other side, Qing Zhu was not lagging far behind.

Her figure in a blue robe suddenly became exceptionally alluring, making one’s eyes unable to look away.

At the same time, her face began to change, revealing a faint "fox shadow," making her appearance even more exquisitely seductive, with eyes flashing a pale pink light.

Anyone who saw these eyes would have their mind devoured by lust.

All Wujiu Tribe generals present sensed the danger and dared not look.

But lust stems from the heart; anyone who saw Qing Zhu’s alluring body couldn’t help but want to see her face.

To see what kind of enchanting face the owner of such a tempting body had.

The Wujiu Tribe generals desperately suppressed their inner restlessness.

A general fond of wine and women couldn’t resist looking at Qing Zhu’s face.

Naturally, she locked eyes with Qing Zhu.

Those were eyes full of affection, striking the heartstrings, extremely alluring.

These eyes seemed to speak, expressing intense love and lust to men, as if looking into them once would make feelings uncontrollable, unable to stop.

The Wujiu Tribe general was captivated by these eyes, his whole body becoming hot and trembling.

Lost in desire, he didn’t realize his divine sense was being drawn out of his Sea of Consciousness, absorbed into Qing Zhu’s eyes.

Once the divine sense is excessively depleted, the surrounding Vermilion Bird Fire would also "take advantage."

The Wujiu Tribe general, losing guard, irresistibly moved toward Qing Zhu, wanting to touch her body, to caress her face.

But his Sea of Consciousness endured the dual burning of Qingqiu Desire Fire and Vermilion Bird Divine Fire, collapsing after only a few steps, dying wish unfulfilled and intention dried.

Even at death, his pale face was still filled with desire.

Within a short time, two Wujiu Tribe generals died.

The Young Master of Wujiu Tribe’s expression was extremely grim.

Meanwhile, with the advantage gained, Yan Zhu and Qing Zhu finally transformed into escape lights, stepping onto the altar.

Setting foot on the altar equated to stepping onto the forbidden ground of "mortals."

For Barbarian cultivators of flesh and blood, this was a "land of death."

But for shamans like Yan Zhu and Qing Zhu, who revere deities and cultivate Witch Dao, this was their "domain."

In the coming situation, only shamans like them can take control.

Mortal cultivators, no matter the height of cultivation, strength of body, or nobility of bloodline, cannot touch the domain of deities.
